race.comment: TORONESS (1) was an excellent winner at Lismore in a similar event to this. She came from midfield then and may have to do that here but the claim will be a big factor. Doubt any type of surface will be against her. Feels the one. MAURRAQA (2) wasn't in the mix at Eagle Farm to end last prep but in reality was not that far off them and it was a heavy track. That does look like his preferred course. BELLARATA (3) scored narrowly by a long neck two back at Lismore but carries more weight here. Expected to be in the finish. CALVARY (7) broke through for a deserved win last time out over 1200m at Kilcoy. Can go on with it.
